issues.what: the atmospheric glow stops in a hard line. The plate ramps from about 17 to 40 over the 8 pixels outside the limb; the frame stays near sky level, then jumps to a hotter, warmer rim (about 166 versus 138 just inside). The sunlit limb also sits about 3 pixels too far in.
issues.fix: widen and soften the falloff, extend the haze outward, cool and dim the rim, and move the sunlit limb back out about 3 pixels

issues.what: same hard short glow and hotter rim, now obvious at native crop size
issues.fix: widen and soften the atmospheric falloff and cool the rim to match panel C of the plate

issues.what: fine ringlet grooves are softer and the dark gaps are filled in. Local groove contrast is down about a quarter (peak-to-trough about 77 to 59). Band positions still match.
issues.fix: deepen the dark gaps and restore fine ringlet contrast; do not blur the rings

issues.where: panels D and G, ring grooves
issues.what: native crops of the ring plane lose the same groove depth. Panel G is the worst (high-frequency energy about 21 percent down); panel D is softer by about 13 percent.
issues.fix: restore ringlet contrast and the black of the gaps in panels D and G

issues.what: the bright rim sits about 2 pixels inside the plate and the haze just outside it is dimmer. The rim highlight that peaks near 166 on the plate arrives later and lower.
issues.fix: push the limb rim outward about 2 pixels and restore the bright haze outside it

issues.what: the planet's shadow line on the rings sits 1 pixel too low, all along the boundary
issues.fix: move the shadow edge up 1 pixel

issues.what: the bright outer edge extends about 2 pixels too far out
issues.fix: pull the outer edge in about 2 pixels

issues.what: the bright ring onset starts about 2 pixels too far left, so the rings bite further across the silhouette
issues.fix: shift that ring edge right about 2 pixels

issues.what: the lit rings run about 3 luma too bright and the bright edges are hotter. The planet interior matches.
issues.fix: drop ring brightness a few luma and ease the hot edges

issues.what: the darkest sky is deeper and a little less blue than the plate (black floor about 3.6 versus 5.1)
issues.fix: lift the black floor and restore the faint blue cast

issues.where: panel E, shadow on the rings; panel H, outer edge; panel C, rings on the dark limb
issues.what: the hold crops show the same 1 to 2 pixel edge misses: shadow line low, outer edge long, ring onset too far across the limb
issues.fix: move the shadow edge up 1 pixel, pull the outer edge in about 2 pixels, and shift the limb-crossing ring edge right about 2 pixels

issues.where: panels B, D, F, and G, sunlit rings
issues.what: those ring crops are about 2 luma too bright, with hotter edges
issues.fix: drop the ring brightness a few luma to match the plate crops
